claude_proposed_widenings.name: stateful_container_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary mechanic is persistent extradimensional storage with access and capacity rules, not a passive grant or an activated ability.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_destruction.non_charge_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Current destruction models only cover charge depletion. This item is destroyed by overload, damage, and a specific cross-item interaction.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed... Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space ... instantly destroys both items...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: cross_item_extradimensional_collision
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current families cannot represent a deterministic item-inside-item collision that destroys both items and releases a hazardous gate effect at the placement location.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other.
